description: Draw an architecture or flow diagram in the chat. YOU write the diagram as Mermaid flowchart text (first line "flowchart LR" or "graph TD"; nodes like A[Web app], B[(Database)], edges like A -->|request| B). This tool lays it out and returns a finished diagram that the view draws inline (MCP Apps hosts; elsewhere the text fallback lists the nodes and edges). Call it with the Mermaid you wrote and show the result as it is: do not edit, re-encode or re-send the returned block, and do not pass it to render_surface. If it is refused, the message says what to fix; correct the Mermaid and call again. Limits: 8192 bytes of Mermaid, at most 12 nodes, 16 edges and 4 subgraphs; larger systems should be split into several diagrams (one per subsystem). Only flowcharts are supported (no sequence, class, state or ER diagrams); colours, styles and click links are not drawn; labels are plain text up to 40 characters, with no HTML or links.

mermaid.description:
Mermaid flowchart text you wrote, for example: flowchart LR
  U[Shopper] --> G[API gateway]
  G --> O[Order service]
  O --> D[(Postgres)]

title.description: Optional title shown above the diagram (plain text, 80 characters at most).

name: draw_architecture
